nextChange: Create the selected minimal local household pantry and prove Rice journey, boundary enforcement and portable maintenance.

sources.summary: Owner confirmed local household outcomes and selected exact vision, destination, scaffold, UI enforcement and maintenance.
TypeScript browser and local storage, no account/server/remote service.
Citation-checked official tool/storage research; native scoped restrictions support selected boundary.
Scratch real Chrome Rice journey, full-name duplicate preservation, storage failure and recovery passed; created target still unverified.

findings.problem: Approved intent and terms need durable authoritative sources without duplicated root guidance.
findings.principle: Use exact approved vision, confirmed glossary, bounded design and pointer-only root guidance.
findings.consequence: Unclear authority would let later changes drift from the agreed local household scope.
findings.fix: Use exact approved vision, confirmed glossary, bounded design and pointer-only root guidance.
findings.verification: Review literal sources, exact approved vision hash, documentation links and maintenance registration.

findings.problem: There is no working first Rice journey at the absent selected destination.
findings.principle: Create a plain DOM browser app, public pantry interface and private validated storage owner.
findings.consequence: The household cannot record needed Rice and retain it on reload.
findings.fix: Create a plain DOM browser app, public pantry interface and private validated storage owner.
findings.verification: Native public behaviour and observed actual Chrome journey including reload, duplicate-state preservation and saving failure.

findings.problem: The selected UI boundary and native quality checks are absent.
findings.principle: Integrate native ESLint private import/storage restrictions, strict types, formatting, public/browser tests and resource limits in npm run check.
findings.consequence: UI bypasses could obscure unsaved state or couple rendering to private persistence.
findings.fix: Integrate native ESLint private import/storage restrictions, strict types, formatting, public/browser tests and resource limits in npm run check.
findings.verification: Independent rule-proof private import and direct storage violations, valid rendering, then integrated npm run check proof; resource guard before suites.

findings.problem: Future edits have no maintained change coverage or standalone review checker.
findings.principle: Install the unchanged dependency-free checker and selected document/rule/scope/acceptance contract.
findings.consequence: A later green unit check alone could omit source impact or real journey coverage.
findings.fix: Install the unchanged dependency-free checker and selected document/rule/scope/acceptance contract.
findings.verification: Validate contract/docs, substantive assessment, captured native evidence and portable checker in a different-root clean clone with isolated home/cache.

limitations: Scratch browser passes are preview evidence, not verification of a created target.
Initial supported browser is installed Chrome on Linux; other browser compatibility is unverified.
Native syntactic boundary checks do not prove all reflective/computed runtime indirection.
No hosted CI, release or delivery service selected.

Standalone findings validate/render require an existing directory; planned-destination validation is blocked until protected creation. Creation dry-run validates the planned change set without creating the destination.
